findings.title: The tide card has no example label, date or height reference

location.description: the heading of the tide card, which says only "Today at Porthmellin"

findings.viewer_experience: A harbor master cannot tell if 4.8 m is live, for which day, or measured from what level, and that is the doubt the headline promises to remove.
findings.target: The card is labeled as an example of the page Tidewell posts, and shows the date and the level the heights are measured from.
findings.fix_direction: Label the card as an example of the page Tidewell posts. Add the date and the level the heights are measured from. Only the maker can supply those two facts: the date and the height reference level.

closed_when.check: In the desktop, phone, tablet and widescreen images, the tide card shows an example label, a date and a height reference level.

findings.title: The card shows only tides, not gate times, pontoon depth or notices

location.description: the tide table in the card, which has four tide rows only

findings.viewer_experience: The paragraph next to the card promises lock gate times, pontoon depth and notices on one page, but the preview shows a plain tide table.

current.value: four tide rows only, no rows for gate times, pontoon depth or notices

findings.target: The card has rows for lock gate times, pontoon depth and notices.
findings.fix_direction: Add rows for those three features only. The maker must supply the values for the gate times, the pontoon depth and the notices.

closed_when.check: In the desktop, tablet and widescreen images, the card has rows for lock gate times, pontoon depth and notices as well as tides.

findings.title: Nothing compares Tidewell with how offices post times now

location.description: the whole page, which has no comparison line or image

findings.viewer_experience: The reader has to take "can stand behind" on trust.
findings.target: One line or image sets Tidewell beside how offices post times now.
findings.fix_direction: Add one line or image that sets Tidewell beside the current method. The maker must supply the comparison.

closed_when.check: In the desktop, phone, tablet and widescreen images, a line or image compares Tidewell with how offices post times now.

findings.title: On the tablet, Notices sits alone in the second row with an empty cell beside it

location.description: the Notices point in the points section on the tablet

findings.viewer_experience: The three equal points read as two plus one left over.

current.value: two columns, with Notices alone in row two

findings.target: The three points stay equal at this width.
findings.fix_direction: Use one column of three stacked points at this width, or three narrow columns.

closed_when.check: In the tablet image, the three points are in one column or in three equal columns, with no empty cell.
